action: I have pitched two or three businesses over the past two ticks. This week I stop waiting for email replies. I call them directly or walk in. I am targeting: the diner (Betty's if she is open to it, or the next closest), any small business near auto row that is still trying to maintain a social media presence and clearly does not have the bandwidth to do it well. My pitch is specific and economic: consumer spending is down 60% from baseline, foot traffic is soft, and local businesses that stay visible and humanly present on social media have a measurable edge over ones that go dark. I know how to do that. Rate: $100 to $150 per month per client. Goal this tick is to land at least one paying client. Even $100 is real income at zero savings. If I close even one client before end of month, that is the first proof that the cert is not just a credential — my skills are already worth something to someone now.
